Join a data and infrastructure team building a platform that turns information from many sources into reliable, up-to-date company intelligence. You will own the platform end to end, from architecture and ingestion to production operations, helping deliver trusted data that powers products.

• Design and build a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

• Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills with tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

• Build queue-based systems with retries, dead-letter handling, and controlled replay.

• Preserve source payloads in Google Cloud Storage and transform them with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated data layers.

• Implement idempotent upserts, data contracts, validation, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures.

• Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns, and integrate enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction.

• Hands-on production experience with dbt and Google Cloud Platform.

• Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX, plus experience with event-driven systems and task queues.

• Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading.

• Experience with data contracts, raw and curated storage, retention policies, automated testing, and pipeline monitoring.

• Web scraping experience and familiarity with entity resolution, data enrichment, or LLM-based extraction are helpful. Experience building platforms from scratch or working in small teams is also valued.
